name: ZenoteVR
summary: Dive into ZenoteVR, a virtual reality experience where you can relax in a virtual cenote. Enjoy the sounds of nature, admire exotic creatures, and find peace in this serene environment. ZenoteVR blends the tranquility of zen with the beauty of a cenote, providing moments of meditation, relaxation, and reconnection with nature. In future updates, we'll continue to add more content to enrich your experience.
